metadata.description: Cross-project learnings bus (T-1217/T-1219). Publishers: each project's lib/publish-learning-to-bus.sh fires after fw context add-learning. Payload schema: {origin_project, origin_hub_fingerprint, learning_id, learning, task, source, date}. Subscribers: lib/subscribe-learnings-from-bus.sh polls and mirrors to .context/project/learnings-received.yaml. Retention: forever.
